description:
RainWatch puts the next rain on your Apple Watch face. The circle reads "IN 16 MIN" until a shower arrives and "FOR 20 MIN" while it lasts, so you can see whether to leave now or wait. You don't need to open an app or take out your phone. It is free, with no ads and no account.

ON YOUR WATCH FACE
• A circle that counts down to the next rain, or to the end of it.
• A wider slot with the rain line for the time ahead.
• Corner and inline complications, and a widget for the Smart Stack.

IN THE APP
• A graph of the rain ahead: when it starts, when it stops and how hard it falls.
• In the Netherlands and the area around it, a radar map. Turn the Digital Crown to move through it.

WHERE THE FORECAST COMES FROM
• The Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg and western Germany: the radar forecast of KNMI, the Dutch national weather institute, up to two hours ahead in five-minute steps.
• Everywhere else: Apple Weather. The next hour where Apple has a next-hour forecast, such as the UK and Ireland; hour by hour in other countries. There is no radar map there.

WHAT IT SHOWS, AND WHEN
• The app says when its forecast was made.
• When the forecast is old, the watch face shows its time instead of a countdown.
• Missing data is never shown as dry.

PRIVACY
RainWatch uses your location to find your forecast, or you can choose a place by name. Your exact position stays on your watch. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking.

RainWatch is made for Apple Watch. There is no iPhone app.

Rain data: KNMI (CC BY 4.0) and Apple Weather.
promotionalText: The next rain on your Apple Watch face, without opening an app. Free, with no ads and no account.
